source.title: Composer ™ for Harmony Function Code Application Manual Volume 1 (Function Codes 1 to 174)

name: Restore
description: The restore function code saves and restores critical block values (e.g., totalizers, counters, timers) to and from nonvolatile random access memory (NVRAM). Tables 140-2 and 140-3 show NVRAM and checkpoint utilization. During normal execution after startup, the internal and output block data referenced by this block goes to NVRAM. After a module power loss or recovery, the block referenced by this function block restores to the last saved state. Saving the block data can be disabled by either boolean input (S2 and S3). Both inputs must be logic 1 for the save to occur. Data restore can be selected upon power restore, mode changes to execute, or both. If the module is offline longer than the maximum downtime, an external timer can be used to trip a digital input on an IMCIS12, IMCIS22, IMQRS12, IMQRS22, IMDSI12, IMDSI13, IMDSI14, IMDSI15 or an IMDSI22 module to prevent a restore after the timer expires. The expired logic state for the digital input is configurable. The data restores to the saved value before the first execution cycle of the configuration. The restore function block must be located at a block number greater than the function block being restored (S1). When restoring a multiple output block (e.g., M/A station function code 80), the lowest output number (N) of that block must be specified by S1.

specifications.label: S2
specifications.description: Block address of save flag:; 0 = no save; 1 = save data to NVRAM if <S3> = 1

specifications.label: S3
specifications.description: Block address of save permissive:; 0 = disabled; 1 = enabled

specifications.label: S4
specifications.description: Restore condition:; X0 = restore on power up; X1 = no restore on power up; 0X = restore on mode changes; 1X = no restore on mode changes
description_lines: X1 = no restore on power up

specifications.label: S5
specifications.description: I/O module address of timer input
description_lines: I/O module address of timer input

specifications.label: S6
specifications.description: Point number of timer input: unused = 000 DSI = X0Z = Group A (Z = 1 - 8) = X1Z = Group B (Z = 1 - 8) CIS = X2Z (Z = 1 - 3) Expire logic state: 0YZ = logic 0 1YZ = logic 1

notes.text: Maximum values are: 9,998 for the BRC-100, IMMFP11/12 31,998 for the HAC
